quote: is an Olympian deity in ancient Greek religion and mythology considered the herald of the gods. He is also widely considered the protector of human heralds, travelers, thieves, merchants, and orators.

statement.id: Hermes adalah dewa Olimpus Yunani, pembawa pesan dewa dan pelindung pelancong serta pedagang.
statement.en: Hermes is a Greek Olympian herald of the gods and protector of travelers and merchants.

quote: Hermes plays the role of the psychopomp or "soul guide"—a conductor of souls into the afterlife.

statement.id: Hermes berperan sebagai pembimbing jiwa menuju alam kematian.
statement.en: Hermes serves as a guide of souls to the afterlife.

quote: HERMES was the Olympian god of herds and flocks, travellers and hospitality, roads and trade, thievery and cunning, heralds and diplomacy, language and writing, athletic contests and gymnasiums, astronomy and astrology.

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Hermes dewa ternak, pelancong, jalan, perdagangan, kecerdikan, pembawa pesan, dan diplomasi.
statement.en: Theoi identifies Hermes with flocks, travelers, roads, trade, cunning, heralds, and diplomacy.

quote: Hermes was depicted as either a handsome and athletic, beardless youth or as an older, bearded man, with winged boots and a herald's wand.

statement.id: Hermes digambarkan sebagai pemuda tanpa janggut atau pria tua berjanggut dengan sepatu bersayap dan tongkat pembawa pesan.
statement.en: Hermes is shown as a beardless youth or older bearded man with winged boots and a herald's wand.

quote: One of the cleverest and most mischievous of the 12 Olympian gods, Hermes was their herald and messenger.

statement.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Hermes pembawa pesan dewa-dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: World History Encyclopedia calls Hermes the Olympian gods' herald and messenger.

quote: To the Romans, the god was known as Mercury.

statement.id: Bangsa Romawi mengenal Hermes sebagai Mercury.
statement.en: Romans knew Hermes as Mercury.

quote: In that position, he came to symbolise the crossing of boundaries in his role as a guide between the two realms of gods and humanity.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kedudukannya sebagai utusan, Hermes menjadi lambang penyeberangan batas sebagai pemandu antara dua alam, dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in his position as herald he came to symbolise the crossing of boundaries as a guide between the realms of gods and humanity.

quote: He invented the lyre, the alphabet, and dice. The latter explains why the god was beloved by gamblers.

statement.id: Hermes dikisahkan menciptakan lira, alfabet, dan dadu; yang terakhir menjelaskan mengapa para penjudi memujanya.
statement.en: Hermes is said to have invented the lyre, the alphabet, and dice; the latter explains why gamblers loved him.

quote: Hermes was the patron of shepherds and invented the panpipes they used to call their flock.

statement.id: Hermes adalah pelindung para gembala dan menciptakan seruling pan yang mereka pakai untuk memanggil kawanan.
statement.en: Hermes was the patron of shepherds and invented the panpipes they used to call their flock.

quote: With origins, then, as an Arcadian fertility god who had a special love for the Peloponnese, the ancient Greeks believed Hermes was the son of Zeus and the nymph Maia (daughter of the Titan Atlas) and that he was born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia.

statement.id: Dengan asal-usul sebagai dewa kesuburan Arkadia yang sangat mencintai Peloponnesos, orang Yunani kuno percaya Hermes putra Zeus dan nimfa Maia (putri Titan Atlas) dan lahir di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia.
statement.en: With origins as an Arcadian fertility god with a special love for the Peloponnese, the ancient Greeks believed Hermes was the son of Zeus and the nymph Maia (daughter of the Titan Atlas) and was born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia.

quote: While still a baby, he stole his half-brother Apollo's herd of 50 sacred cattle from Pieria, cleverly reversing their hoofmarks by adding bark shoes to make it difficult to follow their tracks.

statement.id: Ketika masih bayi, Hermes mencuri kawanan 50 ternak suci milik saudara tirinya, Apollo, dari Pieria, dengan cerdik membalik jejak kuku dengan menambahkan sepatu kulit kayu agar sulit dilacak.
statement.en: While still a baby, Hermes stole his half-brother Apollo's herd of 50 sacred cattle from Pieria, cleverly reversing their hoofmarks with bark shoes to make them hard to track.

quote: After a hearing before Zeus and the Olympian gods, Hermes was permitted to hold on to the herd (now down to 48 as he had already sacrificed two of them) if he gave Apollo his lyre.

statement.id: Setelah sidang di hadapan Zeus dan para dewa Olimpus, Hermes boleh menyimpan kawanan ternak (kini tinggal 48 karena dua telah ia korbankan) dengan syarat memberikan lira kepada Apollo.
statement.en: After a hearing before Zeus and the Olympian gods, Hermes was permitted to keep the herd (now 48, since he had sacrificed two) if he gave Apollo his lyre.

quote: Perhaps most celebrated was his killing of the many-eyed (some accounts say 100-eyed) monster Argos on the orders of Zeus in order to free Io.

statement.id: Yang mungkin paling termasyhur adalah pembunuhan monster bermata banyak (sebagian kisah menyebut 100 mata), Argos, atas perintah Zeus untuk membebaskan Io.
statement.en: Perhaps most celebrated was his killing of the many-eyed (some accounts say 100-eyed) monster Argos on Zeus's orders to free Io.

quote: One of his most famous regular roles was as a leader of souls to the river Styx in the underworld, where the boatman Charon would take them to Hades.

statement.id: Salah satu peran rutinnya yang termasyhur adalah menuntun jiwa ke Sungai Styx di dunia bawah, tempat juru perahu Charon membawa mereka ke Hades.
statement.en: One of his most famous regular roles was leading souls to the river Styx in the underworld, where the boatman Charon would take them to Hades.

quote: Another hero helped by the god was Perseus, Hermes giving him an unbreakable sword or sickle (harpe) of adamantine and guiding him to the three Graeae who would reveal the location of Medusa.

statement.id: Pahlawan lain yang dibantu Hermes adalah Perseus: Hermes memberinya pedang atau sabit (harpe) adamantin yang tak patah dan menuntunnya ke tiga Graiai yang akan menunjukkan lokasi Medusa.
statement.en: Another hero helped by Hermes was Perseus: Hermes gave him an unbreakable sword or sickle (harpe) of adamantine and guided him to the three Graeae who would reveal Medusa's location.

quote: Hermes gives particular help to Odysseus, especially on his long return voyage to Ithaca (as told in Homer's Odyssey), for example, giving him an antidote to the spells of Circe.

statement.id: Hermes membantu Odiseus secara khusus, terutama pada pelayaran pulangnya yang panjang ke Ithaka (dalam Odyssey karya Homeros), misalnya dengan memberinya penawar mantra Kirke.
statement.en: Hermes gives particular help to Odysseus, especially on his long voyage home to Ithaca (as told in Homer's Odyssey), for example by giving him an antidote to Circe's spells.

quote: He was the patron of travellers, and stone pillars (hermae) with a phallus symbol were often to be seen set up along roadsides to act as guides and offer good fortune to those who passed.

statement.id: Hermes adalah pelindung para pelancong, dan tugu batu (hermai) dengan lambang falus sering dipasang di tepi jalan sebagai penunjuk dan pembawa keberuntungan bagi yang lewat.
statement.en: Hermes was the patron of travellers, and stone pillars (hermae) with a phallus symbol were often set up along roadsides as guides and to offer good fortune to passers-by.

quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical art, Hermes is depicted holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as a herald, the stick is either cleft or with an open figure of 8 at the top), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as a messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes also a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally with a lyre.
locator: How is Hermes Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Hermes digambarkan memegang tongkat kerykeion atau kaduseus (tanda perannya sebagai juru warta), bersandal bersayap (lambang perannya sebagai utusan), berjubah panjang atau kulit macan tutul, kadang bertopi bersayap (petasos), dan sesekali membawa lira.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek art Hermes is shown holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as herald), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally a lyre.

quote: Hermes has a very long history, being mentioned in the Linear B tablets of the Mycenaean civilization, at its height from the 15th to 13th century BCE.

statement.id: Hermes memiliki sejarah yang sangat panjang: ia disebut dalam lempeng Linear B peradaban Mykenai, yang mencapai puncaknya dari abad ke-15 hingga ke-13 SM.
statement.en: Hermes has a very long history, being mentioned in the Linear B tablets of the Mycenaean civilization, at its height from the 15th to 13th century BCE.

quote: Orators regarded the god who transferred words from sender to receiver as their patron, as did interpreters (another group of boundary-crossers) and, even today, the study and interpretation of texts carries his name: hermeneutics.

statement.id: Para orator menganggap dewa yang memindahkan kata dari pengirim ke penerima sebagai pelindung mereka, begitu pula para juru bahasa; hingga kini kajian dan penafsiran teks memakai namanya: hermeneutika.
statement.en: Orators regarded the god who transferred words from sender to receiver as their patron, as did interpreters, and even today the study and interpretation of texts carries his name: hermeneutics.

quote: Hermes was also known as something of a trickster, stealing at one time or another Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

statement.id: Hermes juga dikenal agak sebagai penipu cerdik, yang pada suatu waktu mencuri trisula Poseidon, panah Artemis, dan ikat pinggang Aphrodite.
statement.en: Hermes was also known as something of a trickster, at one time or another stealing Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

quote: Athens had one of the oldest cults to the god where the Hermaia festival for young boys was held annually.

statement.id: Athena memiliki salah satu pemujaan tertua bagi Hermes, tempat festival Hermaia untuk anak laki-laki diadakan setiap tahun.
statement.en: Athens had one of the oldest cults of the god, where the Hermaia festival for young boys was held annually.

quote: Hermes also freed Ares from his year-long imprisonment in a cauldron by the twin Giants Otus and Ephialtes.

statement.id: Hermes juga membebaskan Ares dari penahanan setahun dalam kuali oleh raksasa kembar Otus dan Ephialtes.
statement.en: Hermes also freed Ares from his year-long imprisonment in a cauldron by the twin Giants Otus and Ephialtes.

quote: As a new-born infant Hermes snuck out of his crib, stole the cattle of the god Apollon, and crafted the first lyre from a tortoise-shell. Zeus was so amused by the young god's antics that he granted him a place as one of the twelve supreme gods of Olympos.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, sebagai bayi baru lahir Hermes menyelinap keluar dari buaian, mencuri ternak Apollon, dan membuat lira pertama dari tempurung kura-kura; Zeus begitu terhibur sehingga memberinya tempat sebagai satu dari dua belas dewa agung Olimpos.
statement.en: According to Theoi, as a newborn Hermes snuck out of his crib, stole Apollon's cattle, and crafted the first lyre from a tortoise-shell; Zeus was so amused that he granted him a place among the twelve supreme gods of Olympos.

quote: Hermes transformed the tell-tale, herdsman Battos into a stone as punishment for reporting his theft of Apollon's cattle.

statement.id: Hermes mengubah gembala pembocor, Battos, menjadi batu sebagai hukuman karena melaporkan pencurian ternak Apollon.
statement.en: Hermes turned the tell-tale herdsman Battos into stone as punishment for reporting his theft of Apollon's cattle.

quote: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus) but he was sometimes armed instead with a short sword.

statement.id: Atribut Hermes yang paling khas adalah tongkat juru warta (kerykeion dalam bahasa Yunani, caduceus dalam bahasa Latin), tetapi kadang ia dipersenjatai pedang pendek.
statement.en: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus), though he was sometimes armed with a short sword instead.

quote: Hermes' sacred animals were the ram and the hare. In ancient art he rode on the back of a large ram.

statement.id: Hewan suci Hermes adalah domba jantan dan kelinci; dalam seni kuno ia menunggangi domba jantan besar.
statement.en: Hermes' sacred animals were the ram and the hare; in ancient art he rode on the back of a large ram.

quote: commanded that glorious Hermes should be lord over all birds of omen and grim-eyed lions, and boars with gleaming tusks, and over dogs and all flocks that the wide earth nourishes, and over all sheep; also that he only should be the appointed messenger to Hades
locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes (trans. Evelyn-White)

statement.id: Himne Homerik 4 menyatakan Zeus memerintahkan Hermes menjadi penguasa atas burung pertanda, singa, babi hutan, anjing, semua kawanan, dan semua domba, serta satu-satunya utusan yang ditunjuk ke Hades.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 4 says Zeus commanded that Hermes be lord over birds of omen, lions, boars, dogs, all flocks and all sheep, and the only appointed messenger to Hades.

quote: he is said to have invented the alphabet, numbers, astronomy, music, the art of fighting, gymnastics, the cultivation of the olive tree, measures, weights, and many other things.
locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes dikatakan menciptakan alfabet, bilangan, astronomi, musik, seni bertarung, senam, budidaya zaitun, ukuran, timbangan, dan banyak hal lain.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology reproduced on Theoi, Hermes is said to have invented the alphabet, numbers, astronomy, music, the art of fighting, gymnastics, olive cultivation, measures, weights, and many other things.

quote: These qualities were combined with similar ones, such as cunning both in words and actions, and even fraud, perjury, and the inclination to steal; but acts of this kind were committed by Hermes always with a certain skill, dexterity, and even gracefulness.
locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes memiliki kecerdikan dalam kata dan perbuatan, bahkan penipuan, sumpah palsu, dan kecenderungan mencuri, tetapi selalu dilakukan dengan keterampilan, kelincahan, dan keanggunan.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes had cunning in words and actions, even fraud, perjury, and an inclination to steal, but always committed with skill, dexterity, and gracefulness.

quote: a son of Zeus and Maia, the daughter of Atlas, was born in a cave of Mount Cyllene in Arcadia ... but Philostratus (Icon. i. 26) places his birth in Olympus.
locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes putra Zeus dan Maia, putri Atlas, lahir di gua di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia, tetapi Philostratos menempatkan kelahirannya di Olimpus.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes, a son of Zeus and Maia, the daughter of Atlas, was born in a cave of Mount Cyllene in Arcadia, but Philostratus places his birth in Olympus.

quote: Apollo presented his young friend with his own golden shepherd's staff, taught him the art of prophesying by means of dice, and Zeus made him his own herald, and also of the gods of the lower world.
locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Apollo memberi Hermes tongkat gembala emasnya dan mengajarinya meramal dengan dadu, dan Zeus menjadikannya juru wartanya sendiri serta juru warta dewa-dewa dunia bawah.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Apollo gave Hermes his golden shepherd's staff and taught him prophesying by dice, and Zeus made him his own herald and herald of the gods of the lower world.

quote: Among the things sacred to him we may mention the palm tree, the tortoise, the number four, and several kinds of fish; and the sacrifices offered to him consisted of incense, honey, cakes, pigs, and especially lambs and young goats.
locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, hal-hal yang suci bagi Hermes mencakup pohon palem, kura-kura, angka empat, dan beberapa jenis ikan, dan kurban untuknya berupa kemenyan, madu, kue, babi, serta terutama domba dan anak kambing.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, things sacred to Hermes included the palm tree, the tortoise, the number four, and several kinds of fish, and offerings to him consisted of incense, honey, cakes, pigs, and especially lambs and young goats.

quote: Hermes has long been derived from Greek ἕρμα (herma 'stone heap, cairn'), but this scholarly speculation is also disputed.

statement.id: Nama Hermes sejak lama diturunkan dari kata Yunani herma ('timbunan batu'), tetapi dugaan ilmiah ini juga diperdebatkan.
statement.en: The name Hermes has long been derived from Greek herma ('stone heap, cairn'), but this scholarly speculation is also disputed.

quote: The earliest form of the name Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) is the Mycenaean Greek ... in the Linear B syllabic script.

statement.id: Bentuk tertua nama Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) adalah bentuk Yunani Mykenai yang ditulis dalam aksara silabis Linear B.
statement.en: The earliest form of the name Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) is the Mycenaean Greek form written in the Linear B syllabic script.

quote: According to a theory that has received considerable scholarly acceptance, Hermes originated as a form of the god Pan

statement.id: Menurut satu teori yang diterima cukup luas oleh para sarjana, Hermes berasal dari suatu bentuk dewa Pan.
statement.en: According to a theory that has received considerable scholarly acceptance, Hermes originated as a form of the god Pan.

quote: Perhaps the most celebrated depiction of Hermes in Greek art is the magnificent statue by Praxiteles (c. 330 BCE) which once stood in the temple of Hera at Olympia and now resides in the archaeological museum of the site.
locator: How is Hermes Represented in Art?

statement.id: Penggambaran Hermes dalam seni Yunani yang mungkin paling termasyhur adalah patung agung karya Praxiteles (sekitar 330 SM) yang dahulu berdiri di kuil Hera di Olimpia dan kini berada di museum arkeologi situs itu.
statement.en: Perhaps the most celebrated depiction of Hermes in Greek art is the statue by Praxiteles (c. 330 BCE) that once stood in the temple of Hera at Olympia and now resides in the site's archaeological museum.

quote: In the Hellenistic period, the god was often associated with gymnasia and seen as the protector of youths.

statement.id: Pada periode Helenistik, Hermes sering dikaitkan dengan gimnasium dan dipandang sebagai pelindung kaum muda.
statement.en: In the Hellenistic period the god was often associated with gymnasia and seen as the protector of youths.

quote: In mythology, Hermes was also the father of the pastoral god Pan and Eudoros (with Polymele), one of the leaders of the Myrmidons, although the god was not given a wife in any Greek myth.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi, Hermes juga ayah dewa gembala Pan dan Eudoros (dengan Polymele), salah satu pemimpin bangsa Myrmidon, meski ia tidak diberi istri dalam mitos Yunani mana pun.
statement.en: In mythology Hermes was also the father of the pastoral god Pan and of Eudoros (with Polymele), a leader of the Myrmidons, although he was not given a wife in any Greek myth.

quote: Other accounts, again, refer the theft of the oxen to a more advanced period of the life of the god.
locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, kisah lain menempatkan pencurian ternak pada masa yang lebih lanjut dalam kehidupan sang dewa.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, other accounts place the theft of the oxen at a more advanced period of the god's life.

quote: it is frequently mentioned in the Homeric poems as the magic staff by means of which he closes and opens the eyes of mortals
locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, tongkat Hermes sering disebut dalam puisi Homerik sebagai tongkat ajaib yang dengannya ia menutup dan membuka mata manusia.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes's staff is frequently mentioned in the Homeric poems as the magic staff with which he closes and opens the eyes of mortals.

quote: he is also described as the god who had it in his power to send refreshing sleep or to take it away.
locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes juga digambarkan sebagai dewa yang berkuasa mengirim tidur yang menyegarkan atau mencabutnya.
statement.en: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes is also described as the god who had it in his power to send refreshing sleep or to take it away.

quote: Such tablets have been discovered at Pylos, Thebes, and Knossos.

statement.id: Lempeng semacam itu ditemukan di Pylos, Thebes, dan Knossos.
statement.en: Such tablets have been discovered at Pylos, Thebes, and Knossos.
